in_arabic.name: عادار
in_arabic.meaning: عادار اسم، يعني الشهر الثاني في التقويم العبري
in_arabic.long_meaning: عادار هو الشهر الثاني في التقويم العبري، و هو شهر كريم في السنة اليهودية، و قد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: عدار
in_urdu.meaning: عدار نام، عبرانی تقویم کا دوسرا مہینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عدار عبرانی تقویم میں ایک مہینہ ہے، جو یہودی سنہ میں دوسرا مہینہ ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: अदार
in_hindi.meaning: अदार नाम, हिब्रू कैलेंडर का दूसरा महीना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अदार हिब्रू कैलेंडर में एक महीना है, जो यहूदी वर्ष में दूसरा महीना है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी किया गया है

in_pashto.name: ادار
in_pashto.meaning: ادار نوم، د عبراني تقويم دويمه مياشت
in_pashto.long_meaning: ادار د عبراني تقويم يوه مياشت ده، کوم چې د يهودي کال په دويمه مياشت ده، او د قران کريم په اړه يې هم ذکر شوی دی

in_english.name: Adar
in_english.meaning: Adar is the second month in the Hebrew calendar
in_english.long_meaning: Adar is the second month in the Hebrew calendar, it is a month in the Jewish year, and it is mentioned in the Quran. The name Adar has its roots in ancient Semitic languages and is associated with nobility and excellence. In Islamic tradition, the name Adar signifies a person of high moral character and spiritual distinction. Historically, Adar has been used as a given name among Jewish and Muslim communities, symbolizing a connection to their rich cultural heritage. The name Adar embodies qualities of leadership, wisdom, and compassion, making it a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name with deep historical and spiritual significance.

During this time, many Muslims focus on acts of charity, kindness, and seeking forgiveness.

On this day, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) delivered his final sermon to millions of pilgrims gathered at Mount Arafat in Saudi Arabia, emphasizing the unity of humanity in all aspects and reminding everybody to stay firm on their faith and righteousness. Thus, Adar is a reminder for spiritual growth, introspection and commitment towards faith and moral values.
